 Most recent Most popular 'Close from Croatia' published at 21:25 GMT 21:25 GMT 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 Paul Robinson 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Wembley 
 That was close from Croatia. And you can tell from Jordan Pickford's body language that it was close. 
 That was narrowly wide.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 83 mins 83 mins 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 Croatia just starting to creep into this and England need to be careful.
 A draw would be enough to reach the quarter-finals but surely a win would be preferred going into Sunday's match against Spain.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 81 mins 81 mins 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 Just less than 10 minutes to go in this one.
 Nikola Vlasic turns and wriggles free of Dan Burn but his shot drags wide of the goal post.
 42 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:21 GMT 21:21 GMT 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 Rob Green 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Wembley 
 Mixed reception for Ben White. I'm not sure he will be too bothered.
 179 52 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 79 mins 79 mins 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 A few boos for Ben White, who said this week people do not know the "full story" behind his decision to previously make himself unavailable for England selection - but said he would make the same decision again.
 Image source, PA Media 
 112 74 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 78 mins 78 mins 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 And now time for some England changes. 
 Off: Anthony Gordon, Declan Rice and Trent Alexander-Arnold.
 On: Rio Ngumoha, James Garner and Ben White.
 171 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 74 mins 74 mins 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 Another change for the visitors.
 Luka Modric and Marco Pasalic are on for Ivan Smolcic and Josip Misic.
 74 37 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Perfect time for Ngumoha' published at 21:16 GMT 21:16 GMT 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 Paul Robinson 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Wembley 
 I think this is the perfect time for Rio Ngumoha. You look at his pace and how direct he is to run in behind, I think this is the time to give him some minutes.
 201 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:15 GMT 21:15 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 To score on your 126th appearance, just so fitting, it's magic.
 Gary, Preston 
 Great moment from Kane, what a player.
 Gary, Leeds 
 Image source, Reuters 
 418 76 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 73 mins 73 mins 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 This is the fifth time that Harry Kane has scored in at least five successive games for England.
 He has scored seven goals in this Nations League campaign.
 122 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 70 mins 70 mins 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 Slaven Bilic turns to his bench at the 70 minute mark.
 Petar Sucic and Igor Matanovic make way for Ante Budimir and Mario Pasalic.
 42 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:11 GMT 21:11 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 That is how VAR should work. That took less than a minute to give the penalty. Great officiating.
 Chris 
 552 94 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 68 mins 68 mins 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 Lovely to see all of Harry Kane's nearest and dearest celebrating in the crowd.
 The England captain now has 92 goals for his country.
 646 92 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 66 mins 66 mins 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 It was some poor defending from Jarell Quansah for Croatia's equaliser but he has atoned by winning that penalty.
 Ivan Smolcic went into the book for the foul that awarded England a spot-kick, by the way.
 232 82 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Never in doubt' published at 21:08 GMT 21:08 GMT 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 Paul Robinson 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Wembley 
 On a night like tonight, the script was written. It was never in doubt when he put the ball on the spot.
 It's what I like to call his safety penalty. As he sees the goalkeeper go, he lifts it down the middle of the goal yet again. 
 247 66 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Nice moment for Kane published at 21:07 GMT 21:07 GMT 
 England 2-1 Croatia 
 Alex Howell 
BBC Sport England reporter at Wembley 
 A really nice moment for Kane as he put the ball confidently down the middle. 
 He does his trademark celebration as the crowd shows his family celebrating in one of the boxes in Wembley. 
 A big let off for Jarell Quansah too. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 459 92 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - England 2-1 Croatia published at 21:06 GMT 21:06 GMT 
 Harry Kane (64 mins, pen) 
 Never in doubt! 
 Harry Kane goes straight down the middle and the goalkeeper has already committed to diving to his left.
 A cheeky penalty and what a way to mark an historic night for the England skipper.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 2231 242 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY - ENGLAND published at 63 mins 63 mins 
 England 1-1 Croatia 
 The referee doesn't need too much of a look at that incident to make his mind up and award the penalty.
 Harry Kane could mark his 126th cap with a goal...
 987 215 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:04 GMT 21:04 GMT 
 England 1-1 Croatia 
 Paul Robinson 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Wembley 
 Jarell Quansah is getting his shirt pulled for a long time. His shirt is being pulled with his arm around him.
 The referee is going to take a look.
 290 90 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Video Assistant Referee published at 62 mins 62 mins 
 England 1-1 Croatia 
 Referee Morten Krogh has been sent to the monitor to potentially award a penalty.
 Jarell Quansah was having his shirt pulled for a long time.
